description: Add skeleton shimmer and rolling working word animations across components/app/base.coax, base-checks.coax, and components/paint/list.coax.

steps.send: Implement skeleton shimmer and rolling working-word animations for Coder Desktop (#13773) in `components/app/base.coax`, `components/paint/list.coax`, `components/kit/frame.coax`, and `components/app/activity.coax`, with unit tests in `components/app/base-checks.coax`. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test components/app/base-checks.coax`.

graders.run: grep -q app_skeleton components/app/base.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/app/base.coax --only skeleton
